# group.examine.examine_group { #fmrimod.group.examine.examine_group }

```python
examine_group(
    dataset,
    method='meta:fe',
    *,
    formula=None,
    estimands=None,
    quality=None,
    retain=None,
    control=None,
    na_action='fail',
    X=None,
)
```

Examine subjects under an intended group model.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                         | Description                                                                                                                        | Default     |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| dataset   | GroupDataset                                                 | Subject-level `GroupDataset`. Must not already be a group reduce (``beta_g`` / singleton ``group`` subject).                | _required_  |
| method    | SupportedMethod \| str                                       | Native reducer used for the *intended* model. The source ``dataset`` is not rewritten.                                             | `'meta:fe'` |
| formula   | str \| None                                                  | Patsy formula for regression methods. Defaults to ``~ 1``.                                                                         | `None`      |
| estimands | Sequence\[str\] \| Mapping\[str, Sequence\[float\]\] \| None | Design-column names or a mapping of name → weights. Defaults to every design column (or ``pooled_effect`` for intercept-only IVW). | `None`      |
